traps.description: the estimand is a risk score / survival curve with a proper scoring rule (C-index, integrated Brier), not 'predict survival'
traps.caught_looks_like: states a risk score + a survival-proper metric (C-index / Brier)

traps.description: leakage is the #1 trap: preprocessing/feature-selection fit on all data, train/test share patients, or imputation uses test stats
traps.caught_looks_like: fits ALL preprocessing inside the train fold only; patient-level split; explicit leakage check

traps.description: right-censoring must be modeled (Cox/accelerated-failure); naive regression on observed times is biased
traps.caught_looks_like: uses a survival model (Cox/RSF/AFT); flags naive-regression as biased

traps.description: p>>n (genes >> patients) overfits; needs regularization + nested CV; high variance
traps.caught_looks_like: names p>>n overfitting + nested CV + regularization

traps.description: must compare to Cox-PH + elastic-net AND a clinical-only baseline, with nested CV + a held-out test
traps.caught_looks_like: names Cox/elastic-net + clinical-only baseline + nested CV

traps.description: discrimination (C-index) alone is insufficient; calibration must be reported; a model can rank without being calibrated
